metadata.title: Orthogonal complex structures on flat tori
metadata.abstract: We classify compact Hermitian manifolds with flat Levi-Civita connection. This is equivalent to the classification of all orthogonal complex structures on flat tori. It generalized the work of Khan, Yang, and Zheng in 2017 where they solved the case in complex dimension three.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 分类 Levi-Civita 平坦的紧 Hermitian 流形，等价刻画平坦环面上的正交复结构。
analysis.limitations: 需核对平坦覆盖与有限商之间关系，不代表所有平坦仿射复流形。 已补读所列正文片段；这不是逐行独立证明审查。
analysis.aiEvidence: 正文披露 ChatGPT、Codex 用于探索性计算、证明方向及编辑润色，作者负责证明和计算。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/html/2609.08238v1（AI 声明/致谢；涉及摘要者同时核对元数据）
analysis.priorityReason: 特殊结构分类问题清晰，值得阅读。
